facts.heading: Exhausted per GP suggestion
facts.content: Daniel's general practitioner suggested he come because she noticed he looks exhausted.
facts.evidence: She said I look exhausted, and she's right, I am.

facts.heading: Burnout started in October
facts.content: Daniel has been completely burnt out since October.
facts.evidence: I've been completely burnt out since October.

facts.heading: Workload increased after client loss
facts.content: Daniel's company lost a big client, and half of the team was moved onto a rescue plan.
facts.evidence: We lost a big client, half of our team got moved onto the rescue plan,

facts.heading: Daniel doing three jobs
facts.content: Daniel ended up doing three people's jobs after the client loss.
facts.evidence: so I ended up doing three people's jobs.

facts.heading: Works late into the night
facts.content: Daniel starts work at 7 AM and still answers messages until 10 PM.
facts.evidence: I'm at my desk by 7 and I'm still answering messages at 10 at night.

facts.heading: Work thoughts persist at night
facts.content: Daniel continues to think about work even when he is not working.
facts.evidence: Even when I'm not working, I'm thinking about work.

facts.heading: Sleep duration is about 4 hours

facts.evidence: Most nights I sleep about 4 hours.

facts.heading: Wakes up at 3 AM

facts.heading: Wakes up worrying about work
facts.content: When Daniel wakes at 3 AM, he thinks about shipping schedules and clients.
facts.evidence: We have to start shipping schedules, the clients, whether I've forgotten something.

facts.heading: Father diagnosed with Parkinson's

facts.evidence: He was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in the autumn.

facts.evidence: His hands shake. He's slower. He gets frustrated.

facts.heading: Daniel drives father to appointments

facts.evidence: I'm the one who drives him to the hospital and leads.

facts.heading: Appointments take about an hour each way
facts.content: The neurology appointments take about an hour each way.
facts.evidence: Neurology appointments are every few weeks. It's about an hour each way.

facts.evidence: My hungry sister Hannah lives in Toronto,

facts.heading: Does not tell Hannah how he is
